name: iteration-recap
description: Summarizes every Claude Code iteration and lets you browse them: files, repos, PRs, reviews, plans, open questions

summarizer.title: Recap summarizer
summarizer.description: haiku: one-line AI summary per iteration; heuristic: first sentence of the answer, no model call

autoOpen.title: Auto-open recap pane
autoOpen.description: Open the recap pane after each iteration until you close it; /iterations reopens it
